title: AWS Networking
description: Master VPC, subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs, load balancers, Route 53, and CloudFront.
longDescription: Networking connects everything in AWS. This module teaches you how to build secure, scalable networks using Amazon VPC, route traffic with Route 53, and distribute content globally with CloudFront. You will learn about public and private subnets, network address translation, peering, Transit Gateway, and DNS routing policies.
whatYouLearn: Design VPCs with public and private subnets
Configure route tables, IGW, NAT Gateway
Use VPC peering, Transit Gateway, and PrivateLink
